summary: Employee agrees to work for the company for a specified term, performing duties assigned by the Board of Directors. The company may terminate the agreement with one month's notice. The employee must keep their education certificates with the company.

clauses.title: Employee Duties
clauses.original: The Employee shall perform such duties and exercises such powers as may from time to time be assigned to or vested in him by the Board of Directors...
clauses.plain: Employee must perform duties assigned by the Board of Directors.
clauses.reason: Employee may not perform duties as assigned.

clauses.title: Termination
clauses.original: The company may terminate this agreement at any time before the expiry of the stipulated term by giving one month's notice in writing to him.
clauses.plain: Company may terminate agreement with one month's notice.
clauses.reason: Company may terminate agreement for any reason.
clauses.negotiation: Employee has no say in termination.

clauses.title: Education Certificates
clauses.original: As a guarantee you are agreed to keep your all -original education certificates with the custody of (Organization Name) __________________________...
clauses.plain: Employee must keep education certificates with company.
clauses.negotiation: Employee must keep certificates as per agreement.
